why_lead: Quantum takes the lead from the Tesla drawdown because it is now the best-supported coincidence of price and attention. The stocks that the 2025-03-19 lead called Nvidia's seal of approval fell hardest on 2025-03-20, after the chief executive said he was wrong about the quantum timeline (QBTS down 18.02%, IONQ down 9.27%, RGTI down 9.24% in the session), so the catalyst and the reaction both changed. The Tesla drawdown is not kept as a lead: its buy-the-drawdown essay repeats the 2025-03-12 and 2025-03-17 leads, and the new Tesla items (a believer's fundamentals call, federal charges for the attacks, short-side ETFs) point the other way rather than supporting a new buy case.
why_smaller: Leveraged ETFs replace the 2025-03-03 leveraged chip-ETF smaller trade because the story changed: a WSJ headline of 2025-03-20 says billions flowed into new leveraged ETFs and that they are now in free fall, with TQQQ down 31.02% and SOXL down 37.13% over 20 sessions.

Bitcoin miners are a new narrative: IREN's 2.75GW and 600MW grid headline of 2025-03-17 and the SEC mining headline of 2025-03-20 did not stop the group's 20-session slide, with bitcoin flat over the same period.

Palantir returns from the 2025-03-06 smaller trade on a changed catalyst: a US$19 million buyback on 2025-03-18 and a 17% surge after it, with Reddit and analyst attention on 2025-03-17 and 2025-03-19.
considered_not_chosen: Tesla: the buy-the-drawdown essay repeats the 2025-03-12 and 2025-03-17 leads and the 2025-03-19 short-seller smaller trade; the new believer, charges and short-ETF items do not yet support a distinct buy case, so Tesla is held back, not dropped for good.
